title: Checkout

header.title: Checkout
header.subtitle: Review your order and complete your purchase securely.

form.fiscalHint: Needed only if you want a Mexican tax invoice. Copy the values from your Constancia de Situación Fiscal.
form.legalNamePlaceholder: As printed on your Constancia, without S.A. de C.V.

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.termsRequired: Please agree to the Terms & Conditions.

payment.paypalDesc: Pay securely with your PayPal account, debit, or credit card. Buyer protection included.
payment.mercadoPagoDesc: Pay with Mexican cards, OXXO, SPEI, and other LATAM methods.
payment.secure: Secure checkout via PayPal and Mercado Pago
payment.cancelled: PayPal checkout was cancelled. You can try again.
payment.renderFailed: Unable to render PayPal button. Please refresh and try again.
payment.startFailed: Failed to start checkout. Please try again.

delivery.label: Digital delivery
delivery.subtitle: Download immediately from your dashboard after payment

terms: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

success.title: Thank you for your order!
success.subtitle: Your downloads are ready.
success.processingMP: Payment is being processed by Mercado Pago. This page will update automatically within 20 seconds.
success.checkEmail: Check your email for the order confirmation and receipt, usually arrives within a minute.
success.orderPreparing: Order details are being prepared. Refresh the page in a moment if you don't see them.
success.failedSubtitle: Your payment could not be processed. Please try again.
success.confirmingSubtitle: Waiting for payment confirmation. This takes a moment…
success.pendingTimeoutSubtitle: The payment provider has not confirmed yet.
success.pendingTimeoutBody: We'll email you the moment the payment is confirmed. Your downloads will be waiting in your dashboard.
success.downloadsSubtitle: Ready now. Re-download any time from your dashboard.
success.noDownloads: No downloadable files in this order.
success.downloadError: Download failed. Try again from your dashboard.
success.receiptPreparing: Receipt PDF is being generated and will be attached to your confirmation email.
success.receiptError: Could not download the receipt right now.
success.claimTitle: Check your email to claim your account
success.claimBody: We created an account for the email you used at checkout and sent you a link to set your password.
success.claimDownloads: Once you sign in, your files are waiting in your downloads dashboard.
success.claimSignIn: I already have an account — sign in
success.notYourOrder: This order belongs to a different account. Sign in with the account you used at checkout to see its downloads.

errors.notEntitled: You don't have access to this file. If this is unexpected, contact support.
errors.fileMissing: This file is temporarily unavailable. Our team has been notified.
errors.limitExceeded: You've reached the download limit for this file.
errors.loginRequired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again to download.

next.emailDesc: Check your inbox for the order confirmation and receipt.
next.readyDesc: Your digital products are available immediately, here and in your dashboard.
next.accessDesc: Re-download your purchases and future updates any time from your dashboard.

success.paymentPendingSubtitleCash: Your order is reserved — pay the OXXO voucher to finish.
success.paymentPendingSubtitleTransfer: Your order is reserved — complete the SPEI transfer to finish.
success.paymentPendingBodyCash: Take the voucher to any OXXO store and pay the exact amount. Mercado Pago will confirm the payment, usually within one business day.
success.paymentPendingBodyTransfer: Send the SPEI transfer from your banking app using the details on the payment page. Mercado Pago usually confirms within minutes.
success.paymentPendingAutoUpdate: This page updates automatically. Your downloads unlock the moment Mercado Pago confirms the payment — we will email you too.

misc.noChargeBody: No charge was made to your account. You can return to checkout and try again.
misc.addressOptional: Optional, used for invoices and tax receipts.
misc.addOneTail: to speed up future checkouts, or proceed without one.
misc.mpRedirect: You'll be redirected to Mercado Pago's secure checkout. Accepted: cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), OXXO, SPEI, Mercado Pago wallet.
